criteria.notes: No hard age cutoff. Prefer older vans when comparable, but list any Solis that looks like a strong deal on price, miles, condition, and location. Soft preference remains for model year ≤2021 when ranking equals.

marketSummary.verdict: Deal-first ranking: the active private 2022 in Renton at $68k remains the strongest local budget lead (~$8k over target). Pottstown’s $63,994 2022 remains the national low ask, while a verified Smyrna 2021 at $69,900 adds an age-preferred fly option.

projections.budgetReachability: A $60k purchase is most plausible via negotiation on the Renton private van, the high-mileage Pottstown fly deal, or seasonal softening. Smyrna adds a verified 2021 fly option just under $70k.

extraCashNeeded.notes: WA sales/use tax (~8–10%), title/license, Class B insurance binder, and pre-purchase inspection. Ask lenders whether tax/fees can roll into the loan.

financing.recommendation: Get preapproved for a secured RV loan at BECU plus one other WA credit union before negotiating. $20k down is strong (~25–33% on a $60–78k van). Prefer ≤10-year terms if the payment fits; use dealer financing only as a comparison quote.

paymentAssumptions.disclaimer: Illustrative mid-2026 planning estimates using published credit-union “as low as” ranges. Not an offer or credit decision.

lenders.name: BECU (WA)
lenders.notes: Often 10–20% down on longer terms; gas RVs typically ≤75k miles.
lenders.fit: Best first call if you're in Washington

lenders.name: Alliant Credit Union
lenders.notes: RV ≤15 years old and <75k miles; private-party max often $100k.

lenders.name: Fibre FCU / other WA CUs
lenders.notes: Membership and age/mileage caps vary — confirm before applying.

lenders.name: Navy Federal (if eligible)
lenders.notes: Military affiliation required; $0 down possible for well-qualified borrowers.

lenders.name: LightStream / unsecured
lenders.notes: No RV age/mileage lien rules; needs strong credit.
lenders.fit: Backup if secured RV rules block the van

lenders.name: Dealer / indirect
lenders.notes: Convenient closing, but compare against a credit-union preapproval.
lenders.fit: Use as leverage, not the default

nextSteps: Get preapproved at BECU + one other WA credit union for a $40–60k RV loan
Ask each: max term, min down, max miles/age, and whether private-party purchases are OK
Keep $6–10k liquid beyond the $20k down for tax, title, insurance, and inspection
Negotiate with a preapproval letter in hand; aim high-$60ks on NW 2021 stock when possible
Compare any dealer rate only after you have a credit-union quote
